title: thysanobotrya scandens

This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Thysanobotrya scandens include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help in treating various diseases.
